description: This file contains database schema initialization, seed data functions, and CRUD operations for a mobile repair service backend, including tables for bookings, services, device models, admin users, and site content.

methods.name: get_db_path
methods.description: Returns the SQLite database path from environment variables or defaults to a local file.

methods.name: init_schema
methods.description: Creates database tables if they do not exist and seeds initial data.

methods.name: list_services
methods.description: Retrieves list of services ordered by display order.

methods.name: list_booking_services
methods.description: Retrieves list of repair services for booking UI.

methods.name: list_models_for_brand
methods.description: Retrieves list of device models for a specific brand.

methods.name: get_site_content
methods.description: Fetches site content entries for specified keys.

methods.name: create_customer_request
methods.description: Inserts a new customer request and returns its ID.

methods.name: create_booking
methods.description: Creates a new booking record and returns its ID.

methods.name: update_booking_device_selection
methods.description: Updates device and service selection for a booking.

methods.name: list_bookings
methods.description: Lists recent bookings for admin panel.

methods.name: get_booking_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a booking by its ID.

methods.name: get_latest_booking_by_phone
methods.description: Retrieves the latest booking for a given phone number.

methods.name: update_booking_status
methods.description: Updates the status and notes of a booking.
